title: Juror
summary: JU'ROR, noun [Latin jurator; or rather juro, to swear.] One that serves on a jury; one sworn to deliver the truth on the evidence given him concerning any matter in question or on trial.

inlines.v: JU'ROR, noun [Latin jurator; or rather juro, to swear.] One that serves on a jury; one sworn to deliver the truth on the evidence given him concerning any matter in question or on trial.
